title: Spending Add-On in Ridgeline Consumer Credit Payoff Autopay Drafts
content:
A Ridgeline Consumer Credit deferred-interest payoff plan whose card is still being used for everyday purchases carries a spending add-on in its fixed draft amount. The add-on turns on the account's purchases on the standard revolving plan in the last 3 months (dated less than 3 full months before today):

| Standard-plan purchases on the account in the last 3 months | Spending add-on |
|---|---|
| total 500.00 or more | 40.00 |
| total more than zero but less than 500.00 | 20.00 |
| none | nothing |

**How it is applied.** The spending add-on is added to the fixed draft amount once that amount has been rounded up to the whole dollar, so the add-on is never itself rounded up or divided.

## Questions answered

**Which purchases count?** Posted purchases on this card on the standard revolving plan. Purchases on a deferred-interest plan or on 84 fixed monthly payments are not standard-plan purchases.

**Purchases of 499.99 in the 3 months?** 20.00. **Of exactly 500.00?** 40.00. **No standard-plan purchase at all?** No add-on.

**Hypothetical:** a whole-dollar draft of 200.00 with 650.00 of standard-plan purchases in the last 3 months becomes 240.00.
